title: Plants
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names ways of caring for plants with local materials: watering at the roots, manuring, mulching, weeding and fencing.

floor.question: Which part of a plant is under the soil?

representations: a watering can and a bottle with holes
steps: Name ways of caring for plants.
contexts: the school garden in the dry season

board.do: Draw a plant with roots under the soil and a child with a can.
Wait for the child to say on the soil near the roots.
Draw the water at the roots and add mulch.

misconceptions.ask: Where should you pour water when watering a plant?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the roots under the soil. Say: roots drink the water.

misconceptions.ask: Is it good to pour water until the pot overflows every hour?
misconceptions.repair: Watch a flooded seedling wilt. Water a little each morning or evening.

misconceptions.ask: Is cow dung good or bad for plants?
misconceptions.repair: Grow two bean plants, one with manure. Compare after two weeks.

misconceptions.ask: Why do farmers put dry grass around plants?
misconceptions.repair: Feel the soil under mulch and bare soil at noon.

checks.question: Name one way of caring for plants.
What local material can be used as manure?
